errors.text_span: Das Diagramm stellt die Terminpreiskurve für Jahreslieferungen im Marktgebiet von Trading Hub Europe (THE) dar.
errors.evidence: The figure contains two separate charts, not a single one. This sentence only mentions the title of the right chart ("Terminpreiskurve für Jahreslieferungen") and presents it as the subject of the entire figure, ignoring the left chart.

errors.text_span: Die erste Linie ist blau... Die zweite Linie ist ebenfalls blau...
errors.evidence: The figure does not show a single chart with two lines. It shows two separate charts, each with its own single line. Describing them as a "first line" and "second line" within a single chart context is a fundamental misrepresentation of the figure's structure.

errors.text_span: Die x-Achse ist linear skaliert und reicht von 2025 bis 2027
errors.evidence: This x-axis range only applies to the left chart. The right chart's x-axis ranges from 2026 to 2029. The description incorrectly treats the two different axes as one.
The description completely omits the purpose of the left chart, which is titled "Terminpreiskurve für Sommerlieferungen" (Forward price curve for summer deliveries).
This is stated for both lines, but both lines in the charts clearly have blue square markers at each data point.

errors.text_span: sinkt kontinuierlich auf 33,3 Euro/MWh im Jahr 2027
errors.evidence: This phrase describes the first line (left chart). However, the value for the left chart in 2027 is approximately 31 Euro/MWh. The value 33.3 Euro/MWh appears to be taken from the right chart's 2027 data point. The description incorrectly mixes data between the two separate charts.
The line in the right chart begins in 2026 at a value just below 40 Euro/MWh, approximately 39 Euro/MWh. The stated value of 40.2 is incorrect.

The description of the line in the right chart ends prematurely at the year 2028. It omits the final data point for the year 2029, which has a value of approximately 27 Euro/MWh, and thus fails to describe the full extent of the data series.
